summary.text: Steve Rutherford is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 43, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Brad Overcash (R).
In a Ballotpedia survey, Rutherford described himself as a U.S. Navy veteran and lifelong Gaston County resident.

paragraphs.text: Steve Rutherford said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running to restore integrity, accountability and basic decency to state government.
He listed expanding access to good-paying jobs, workforce training and small-business growth among his priorities.
Rutherford also said he would work to protect health care access and defend Social Security and Medicare.
